en: Easy now. You'll just have to wait for the Harvest Festival.
Itching for the Harvest Festival already, eh?
Heh, you're daft,
the waiting is the best part of it, isn't it?
Oh, it's you. You still can't wait for the Harvest Festival,
by the look of it.
But, you know,
the landlord's laid up sick this year, isn't he?
I'm worried we won't get to hold the festival.
Well, worry for the landlord is one thing,
but I'm swamped brewing for the festival.
Once the landlord is back on his feet,
and the Harvest Festival is finally on,
it'd be a disgrace if we had no drink.
After all, the folks in this village
are every last one of them drinkers, you see,
so it's work worth doing, I tell you.
You who provide the villagers with drink.
There is something I'd rather drink than liquor.
As for that,
note: 'As for that,' + #1540 reads in msg 70692; #1540 also stands alone in msg 70708

en: I will not wait for the Harvest Festival.
Restraint is not my aesthetic, you see...
I'm off to start a batch of brew now.
What can I do for you?
note: Needs M0#1516 (slice 018) to end a sentence, e.g. "I'm Southwark, I run this place."

en: I leave everything to you. Your orders...
These days, I feel so much better...
You are my master. Your orders...
Is he asleep...?
note: Referent inferred: Daedalus (male, glossary) seen asleep; could be spoken to him ('Are you asleep...?')

en: I am Daedalus, the landlord here.
And you?
It seems you came while I was asleep,
I am sorry.
But lately even rising is a chore.
Now then, who are you, exactly?
Hm...
It is a name I have heard in the old legends,
would you be surprised if I said so?
No.
I thought not. Even if it's an old lord's name,
it can still be a name of today,
after all.
I'm tired from talking. I'll rest a while.
I'm a gravely ill man.
Come again.
I'm tired from talking. Let me rest a while.
As for you,
you seem to be blending into the village fast.
The villagers, wary of you as an outsider at first,
soon hardly mind you at all.
Is it your good character,
or the way the times are changing...?
Have you met my granddaughter, Veta?
She is a pitiable child, too. Because of me, her
parents were made to part in unhappiness.
Even so, now,
she looks after me in my illness.
She is a kind child.
That child should have a happiness of her own,
and I wish she would find it...
I'm not well today.
I can't talk much, but what is it?
How much do you understand about me?
That matter, is it...
The truth is, Doctor Seward visits me,
and he claims to be a vampire hunter
as well.
And a sick man hears rumors, too.
A sick man has plenty of time to think.
Reaching a conclusion is easy.
I see. And?
What do you mean, "and"?
I shall do nothing.
I am a sick man.
I will soon be called to God's side.
I merely resent this body of mine.
At the very least, I want to live until Veta finds
note: Cut at 'finds' / 'a happy partner' to match the Japanese split

en: a happy partner. That is my wish.
As long as I remain in this state,
I suppose that girl will never think of finding a sweetheart.
So, you came...
